name: idea-to-3d
description: Turns a one-line character or prop idea into a textured, rigged, animated 3D model (.glb) with a preview sheet: concepts, image-to-3D, rigging and clips on Meshy, finishing in headless Blender 5.2. Before each checkpoint an independent Gemini critic (Antigravity CLI, Claude fallback) reviews the stage and a reviser applies free fixes; fixes that spend credits run only after approval. Five skills, three agents. Needs Windows, Blender 5.2 and agy; bundles the meshy MCP.
